title: Index Adder by Cycle for C&I Index Line Corrections
content:
*Scope: Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts. Subject: index line corrections: the adder the cycle carries.*

The index adder of the index line correction follows the cycle: a cycle that began on or before the contract end date on a block and index contract carries no adder, because the block price carries the margin, and so does a holdover cycle, one that began after the contract end date, when the structure waives the holdover adder for a late expiry notice and the contract's expiry notice was missing or issued outside the window from 120 to 60 days before the contract end date; any other holdover cycle carries the holdover adder; every other cycle carries the contract rate.

The expiry notice read is the contract's expiry notice with the latest notice date; it is inside the window when the calendar days from its notice date to the contract end date are no more than 120 and no fewer than 60.

| Structure | Holdover adder | Expiry notice window, days before contract end | Holdover adder waived for a missing or late expiry notice |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | 0.85 cents per kWh | 120 to 60 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | 0.85 cents per kWh | 120 to 60 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | 0.85 cents per kWh | 120 to 60 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | 0.85 cents per kWh | 120 to 60 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | 0.85 cents per kWh | 120 to 60 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | 0.85 cents per kWh | 120 to 60 | yes |

## Adder by cycle

| Cycle | Expiry notice | Adder |
|---|---|---|
| Block and Index, began on or before the contract end date | not relevant | none |
| Real-Time Index, began on or before the contract end date | not relevant | the contract rate |
| holdover, any structure | issued 90 days before the contract end date | 0.85 |
| holdover, any structure | issued 45 days before the contract end date | none |
| holdover, any structure | issued 130 days before the contract end date | none |
| holdover, any structure | none issued | none |
